svg.title: Character sheet: powers and gadgets
svg.desc: A trading card for Bookantna. Class: data engineer in training. Home base: Khon Kaen, Thailand. Alignment: chaotic good. Special move: paired bootstrap, ten thousand hits. Weakness: leaky train and test splits. Powers and gadgets. Languages: Python, SQL, C/C++, Java. Machine learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LightGBM. Data: Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter, LangChain, FastAPI. Tools: Git, Docker, Spring Boot, Swift, VS Code. Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle.
